note: Engineering starting thresholds, fixed before any test-set read. Tune on validation and bump the version; never retune after reading the locked test. Not clinical criteria.

gaze_residual.primaryMetric: medianPx on val/locked_test (target-proxy error; not eye-tracker accuracy)
gaze_residual.promotion: human approval recorded in model-registry.json after shadow in /condition and an approved small canary; never automatic on data or training events

rppg_quality.rule: at equal coverage MAE must improve, or at equal MAE coverage must improve; more output with higher error fails
rppg_quality.hrvNote: HR-only references never validate IBI/HRV; beat-dependent claims stay marked unverified after promotion
